text: its ok but not what we thought it would be. it will serve the purpose in the shower but not near what we were expecting.  It tilts forward so we have to be careful not to bump it or the bottles tip out, the baskets are not as sturdy as we had hoped for.

product_metadata.title: Zenna Home Hanging Shower Caddy, Over the Door, Rust Resistant, with 2 Storage Baskets, Soap Dish, Razor Holders and Hooks, Bathroom or Kitchen Shelf Organizer, No Drilling, Stainless Steel
features: QUALITY STAINLESS STEEL CONSTRUCTION: Protects against rust in your bath or shower
IDEAL STORAGE SOLUTION FOR SHOWERS WITH GLASS/DOOR ENCLOSURES: Caddy easily mounts on door rail, with no tools needed
ROOM FOR ALL YOUR SHOWER ESSENTIALS: Caddy includes 2 large storage baskets, soap dish and holders for razors, washcloths and shower poufs
YOUR BATH ITEMS STAY DRY: Installation on shower door rail keeps bath products out of the way of your shower
FITS ON ANY STANDARD SHOWER DOOR ENCLOSURE: Use caddy on any enclosure with a door up to 2.5 inches thick; includes suction cups to keep caddy firmly against shower door
description: If your bathroom has a shower door enclosure instead of a shower curtain, the Zenna Home Over-the-Shower Door Caddy in Stainless Steel is made for you. The caddy fits over most standard shower enclosures to create convenient storage for bath essentials. Stainless steel construction provides strength and protection from rust. The caddy’s two large storage baskets can be adjusted to hold tall bottles. Additional storage comes from a built in soap dish and holders for razors, washcloths and shower poufs. Installation is easy and tool free. The caddy attaches to the sliding door rail (instead of the shower door) so it will not interfere with the shower door’s use. Two suction cups are included to prevent slipping and swaying.
